Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Upholstered High-Back Swivel Chair, 25.2"W, Beige
Colors: Brown
Materials: Textile
With a tall back and low-sloping arms, this modern captain's chair in a usefully neutral beige brings a distinctive flair to your desk or to the conference room. The adjustable height and tilt mechanism provide maximum comfort. 25.2"W x 24.4"D x 41.3–44.3"H Fabric upholstery over plywood and metal frame; metal legs with rollers This modern chair with adjustable height has a 360-degree swivel mechanism; a tilt lock; and waterproof and stain-resistant fabric upholstery. The beige linen upholstery lends an air of refinement to this high-backed modern swivel chair. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
